If the raw value for a boolean-valued property is not a boolean,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties:
            # living is a boolean property.
            living: "string instead of bool"
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            living: false

-- want-errors --
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.living: value discarded: expected boolean, got string
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.living: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.living: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties: {} # Ill-formed property discarded.
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            living:
                definition:
                    label: Living
                    value_type: boolean
                entries:
                -   value: BoolValue{false}
